paper.title: UFO2: The Desktop AgentOS
paper.central_claim: UFO2 is an OS-native Windows desktop AgentOS: hierarchical HostAgent/AppAgents, unified GUI/native APIs, hybrid UIA/vision controls, continuous knowledge retrieval, guarded speculative multi-action execution and non-disruptive PiP together deliver robust, efficient, autonomously improving cross-application automation, outperforming state-of-the-art CUAs. Broad correctness, reliability, efficiency and continuous-improvement claims are preserved rather than replaced by the narrower supported result.

evidence.quote: a multiagent AgentOS that deeply embeds within the Windows OS, orchestrating desktop applications through introspection, API access, and fine-grained execution control.
evidence.support_explanation: Central OS-integration claim; provenance is author report, not demonstrated correctness.

evidence.quote: Upon receiving a user request, HostAgent decomposes it into a series of subtasks, each mapped to the application best suited to fulfill it.
evidence.support_explanation: Actual split/delegate operation.

evidence.quote: CONTINUE: Main execution loop; evaluates which subtasks are ready to launch or resume.
evidence.support_explanation: Explicit host FSM; neighboring states ASSIGN/PENDING/FINISH/FAIL read.

evidence.quote: Shared Blackboard: A concurrent, append-only memory space that facilitates transparent agent communication by recording key observations, intermediate results, and execution metadata accessible to all AppAgent instances.
evidence.support_explanation: Shared session state distinguished from learned parameters and retrieved experience.

evidence.quote: Visual detections with Intersection-over-Union (IoU) greater than 10% against any UIA-derived control are discarded.
evidence.support_explanation: Concrete hybrid control fusion rule; not evidence all discarded controls are redundant.

evidence.quote: Remaining visual-only detections are converted into pseudo-UIA objects using a lightweight UIAWrapper abstraction
evidence.support_explanation: Grounding interface unifies control representation before annotation/execution.

evidence.quote: For each action, the system consults the Windows UIA API to verify the action’s preconditions ( e.g. , is_enabled() , is_visible() ).
evidence.support_explanation: Guard verifies availability/interactivity, not recipient/content/task semantics.

evidence.quote: Actions are executed in order, halting immediately if any validation fails due to interface change
evidence.support_explanation: Early-exit and replan loop, not transaction rollback.

evidence.quote: while preserving the correctness guarantees of per-step validation.
evidence.support_explanation: Author claim stronger than visible/enabled guards establish.

evidence.quote: Applications launched within the PiP session inherit the user’s identity, credentials, settings, and network context
evidence.support_explanation: Input/focus isolation does not imply data, permission or side-effect isolation.

evidence.quote: Windows Named Pipes, authenticated and encrypted using per-session credentials
evidence.support_explanation: Claimed IPC security mechanism, not an independently measured security guarantee.

evidence.quote: the evaluator parses session traces—including actions, rationales, and screenshots—and applies CoT reasoning to decompose tasks into evaluation criteria.
evidence.support_explanation: Experience acceptance uses LLM Task Evaluator, distinct from benchmark script outcomes.

signatures.output: Subtask actions, app-local completion/error, intermediate results and global task termination.
signatures.conditions: Windows accessibility/API coverage; valid worker decomposition and cross-app data handoff; typed executor must satisfy semantics beyond signature.

signatures.object: Speculative predicted action batches insideRDP-loopbackPiP session
signatures.information: Same current app context predicts batch;UIA provides runtime existence/visible/enabled preconditions. Session inherits user identity/credentials/network despite separate focus/input.
signatures.operation: OneLLM call proposes multiple actions; validate each target then execute sequentially; early exit on invalid target with partial results and replan. WindowsRDP loopback isolates foreground input; NamedPipes coordinate host/runtime.

gap.author_gap: Pure visual click agents are fragile, inefficient and disruptive; shallow wrappers miss native application structure, APIs and persistent experience.
gap.checked_gap: Windows-native orchestration and unified accessibility/visual/API control are concrete system responses, but workflow-memory and executable checking are established adjacent mechanisms. Integration breadth does not prove semantic reliability.

lineage/closest_adjacent.relation: Prior induced cross-task workflow memory; residual is its Windows app-scoped deployment withinAgentOS, not first reusable experience.
Co-eval adjacent skill/API synthesis and unit-test loop; not assumed ancestor and not an operation UFO2 performs.
Outcome-based desktop checkers and environment setup underpin reported evaluation; script correction qualifies parity.

gap.residue: Coherent Windows runtime tying host/worker orchestration, control fusion, GUI/COM execution, retrieval and guarded batching;PiP focus isolation as engineering affordance.
gap.stakes: Incorrect desktop writes and credential-bearing side effects can matter more than control validity; multiple manual integration paths raise maintenance cost.
gap.method_response: Explicit FSM/blackboard, typedPuppeteer, visual fallback, document/logRAG,UIA early-exit guards,RDP-loopback.
gap.remaining_gap: Semantic validation/rollback, security-side-effect isolation, independent retained knowledge gains, reproducible script/configuration parity, denominator reconciliation and true end-to-end cost/UX gains.
unresolved: Fixed neighboring sources are unversioned snapshots bound bySHA; no versions invented.
Original UFO predecessor full source is not in fixed relevant bundle; specific novelty over every earlier UFO subsystem not asserted.
No figure-only control/error counts or latency bar heights inferred; unavailable image details remain unknown.
Benchmark script corrections and version parity not enumerated.

condition_checks.reason: Base/Operatorwrapper comparison exists but no clean same-observation/tools role-removal factorial.
condition_checks.condition_name: Each role removed with the same backbone
condition_checks.condition_definition: The paper ablates the progress-summary/planning agent, memory unit, manager or reflector by removing it and reports the drop (SR 88.6 -> 59.1 without the planning agent; instruction SR 56% -> 12% without the manager hub or the reflection agent; subtask SR 76.0 -> 48.1) (2406.01014#s1, 2502.14282#s2, 2502.14282#s3).

condition_checks.reason: No recent-history truncation method claimed.
condition_checks.condition_name: Recent steps at full fidelity, older steps as text, with the window ablated
condition_checks.condition_definition: A few recent screenshots are kept verbatim and older history becomes action text or summaries, with the number of screenshots / history level ablated (three recent screenshots plus L1 action text beats one; L2 text history adds nothing) (2508.09123#s4, 2406.01014#s1).

condition_checks.reason: FSMsupports replan/FAIL/PENDING; semantic self-check not external proof.
condition_checks.condition_name: Proactive replanning or prunable plan trees
condition_checks.condition_definition: The manager replans after every subgoal rather than only on failure (+4.62 / +6.15 points), or the agent maintains a plan tree it can branch and prune (WebArena SR 38.2% -> 43.1%) (2504.00906#s2, 2410.13825#s5).

condition_checks.reason: Early exit observes invalid controls; valid-but-wrong and irreversible effects remain.
condition_checks.condition_name: Reflection on visible, reversible errors
condition_checks.condition_definition: Post-action reflection compares before/after observations in settings where errors show as screen non-change or a recognisably wrong page and are reversible; guidelines plus a post-action success/failure summary lift M3A 19.8% -> 30.6% on AndroidWorld (2401.16158#s3, 2406.01014#s3, 2405.14573#s2).

condition_checks.reason: GPT4o/o1system results; no cross-backbone isolated hierarchy ablation.
condition_checks.condition_name: Hierarchy benefit shown across backbones
condition_checks.condition_definition: Separating planning from action decisions is reported across several backbones (Mobile-Agent-E 75.1 vs 53.0 satisfaction across three backbones) (2501.11733#s1).

condition_checks.reason: Blackboard retainedcontext andACS given, but no causal relevance/retention study.
condition_checks.condition_name: Agent-nominated retained content with step savings
condition_checks.condition_definition: The agent lists pivotal element ids or focus content to keep, and the paper reports both success and steps (WebArena SR 37.1% -> 38.2%, steps 12.0 -> 8.6; removing the focus memory: SR 88.6 -> 77.3) (2410.13825#s4, 2406.01014#s2).

condition_checks.reason: TaskEvaluator/selfstatus may misjudge outcomes; benchmarkscript distinct.
condition_checks.condition_name: Reflector and self-check accuracy unmeasured
condition_checks.condition_definition: Reflection accuracy is as low as 78.8%, executor self-checks and the supervising orchestrator hallucinate, and completion is self-declared without a checker (2406.01014#s3, 2508.03923#s3, 2411.10323#s2, 2312.13771#s3).

condition_checks.reason: Shared summaries can persist inaccurate subtaskstate; not independently measured.
condition_checks.condition_name: Summaries hide errors over long horizons
condition_checks.condition_definition: Summaries returning only the final state hide intermediate mistakes from the orchestrator, long-horizon tasks (>30-50 actions) still lose coherent context, and summary error propagation is not measured (2508.03923#s2, 2508.09123#s4, 2406.01014#s1).

condition_checks.reason: Fullsystem tested twoLLMs; decomposition-specific benefit not separated.
condition_checks.condition_name: Decomposition degrades weaker backbones
condition_checks.condition_definition: With a weaker backbone the full multi-agent framework falls below its single agent (Qwen2.5-VL) (2502.14282#s2).

condition_checks.reason: Privileges/runtime components confounded; no cleanmanagerremoval with fullcost.
condition_checks.condition_name: No role-removal ablation and unreported per-step cost
condition_checks.condition_definition: Several systems give no role-removal ablation, so gains cannot be assigned to the hierarchy alone, while each role adds per-step cost (2501.11733#s1, 2402.07939#s1, 2402.07456#s4).

condition_checks.reason: UIAguard not rollback or harmbound;PiPinheritscredentials.
condition_checks.condition_name: Irreversible actions and state-blind replanning
condition_checks.condition_definition: Plausible-looking wrong pages and irreversible actions (sending messages) defeat screenshot-diff reflection; plan pruning resets only the agent's context, not the web state (2406.01014#s3, 2401.16158#s3, 2410.13825#s5).

condition_checks.reason: 154+49online tasks, with lowcross-app success and no repeats.
condition_checks.condition_name: Loop pathologies on small, baseline-free suites
condition_checks.condition_definition: Repeated actions to the step limit, early stopping triggered by an 'unachievable' hint, loops from caching actions but not outcomes, or retained content that hurts dense single-page tasks, evaluated on small benchmarks without baselines (2307.13854#s4, 2405.14573#s3, 2410.13825#s4, 2401.16158#s2).

condition_checks.condition_definition: Holding a strong planner fixed and adding the grounder is reported (o3 23.0 -> 51.0, GPT-4o 5.0 -> 27.0 on OSWorld with Jedi); replacing GPT-4o's own coordinates with a grounding model's triples OSWorld SR (5.03 -> 14.63 with OS-Atlas-7B) (2505.13227#s2, 2410.23218#s3).

condition_checks.condition_definition: The grounder operates on raw screenshots only, trained at dynamic high resolution (2410.05243#s2, 2412.04454#s3).

condition_checks.reason: Uses existing OmniParser and UIA; does not harvest/mix a rendered grounding-training corpus.
condition_checks.condition_name: Grounding data from rendered structure, mixed and multi-level
condition_checks.condition_definition: Exact element boxes are read from rendered DOM/element trees; mixed data types and multiple levels (icon/component/layout) scale without saturation, and web-only data transfers to desktop/mobile; harvested element-box pairs are curated (dropping static text, balanced per-source sampling: 71.2 -> 74.9) rather than only scaled (2505.13227#s1, 2410.05243#s1, 2401.10935#s1, 2411.17465#s4).

condition_checks.reason: Shared GUI/API dispatch schema is real, but only Windows execution shown; cross-platform zero-shot action normalization is not tested.
condition_checks.condition_name: Unified cross-platform action space
condition_checks.condition_definition: A unified pyautogui action space is used, packing multiple pairs per screenshot; normalising heterogeneous datasets into one shared schema (17 -> 10 action types) helps zero-shot OOD transfer (2412.04454#s1, 2410.23218#s2, 2508.09123#s1).

condition_checks.reason: Element-ID controls use available UIA structure, with pseudo-UIA wrappers for visual fallback; manually registered Office tools match app capability. No context-size/tool-library scaling study.
condition_checks.condition_name: Interface matched to available structure
condition_checks.condition_definition: An element-tag interface is used only where a parseable accessibility tree plus OCR exists; an application-specific tool library fits in context (881 tools, 32K) (2410.08164#s3, 2510.17790#s1).

condition_checks.reason: GUI-only versus GUI+API shown with the same two backbones; no API-only baseline; common-success ACS and ambiguous 27/49 task denominator bound interpretation.
condition_checks.condition_name: Hybrid GUI + code action space compared with each alone
condition_checks.condition_definition: GUI actions are mixed with code/shell/SDK calls and compared against GUI-only and code-only agents on the same benchmark (OSWorld-Verified 60.76% vs 50.68% / 35.73%, with fewer steps per passed task), or the action space is pruned toward what the LLM handles well with each step ablated (WebArena SR 16.5% -> 25.9% -> 31.7%) (2508.03923#s1, 2509.02544#s1, 2410.13825#s1, 2410.13825#s2).

condition_checks.reason: Planning/content mistakes can propagate through a valid control/API interface; availability guards cannot establish semantic correctness.

condition_checks.condition_definition: Planning errors (wrong/vague element descriptions) dominate failures and propagate through the natural-language interface; an end-to-end single model is weaker than with a strong external planner; residual failures are dominated by planning in spreadsheet and multi-app tasks (2410.05243#s2, 2505.13227#s2, 2412.04454#s3, 2410.23218#s3, 2504.00906#s3).

condition_checks.condition_definition: ScreenSpot v1/v2 saturate and there is an offline-online gap (2501.12326#s3).

condition_checks.reason: Custom-control coverage motivates visual fallback; long-tail-icon learning saturation is not measured and no new grounding data scaling claim is made.
condition_checks.condition_name: Data returns diminish on long-tail icons
condition_checks.condition_definition: Diminishing returns after ~100K screenshots; long-tail and idiosyncratic icons cause grounding errors on mobile/desktop (2410.05243#s1, 2410.05243#s2).

condition_checks.reason: COM selection APIs circumvent some coarse GUI actions; the IoU discard and pseudo-UIA representation may still lose fine targets. No independent sub-element granularity audit.
condition_checks.condition_name: Interface granularity too coarse
condition_checks.condition_definition: Element-ID grounding cannot target sub-element positions (grounding errors in 53% of failures); pruned or compressed action spaces drop actions other sites need (hover/press/tabs untested) or lose fine-grained actions (letter-level drag-select) (2410.08164#s3, 2410.13825#s1, 2508.09123#s1).

condition_checks.reason: GPT4o/o1 use tools, but no small/open-backbone tool-use study or API-only coverage control; limited three-app manual APIs prevent general tool robustness inference.
condition_checks.condition_name: Tool interface unused by small models
condition_checks.condition_definition: Tool gains are modest at 7B (+1.9); small models rarely call tools and make harmful tool calls before RL; hybrid code actions need a strong reasoning orchestrator (o4-mini drops to 43.43%) and code-only cannot handle apps without scripting access (2510.17790#s1, 2508.03923#s1, 2402.07456#s1).

matches.reason: C11 unifiesGUI/nativeAPI execution. StaticAPIbindings are not learned or synthesizedskillimprovement. Nofourthmain added forhybridobservation.
matches.condition_note: Conditions are claim-appropriate check questions, not a counted scoring denominator. Risk denotes plausible unexcluded failure, not an observed event unless explicitly stated.

condition_checks.reason: Knowledge is tailored to benchmark environments/apps and includes successful local runs. Same-environment construction is an applicability affordance, not proof of held-out generalization.
condition_checks.condition_name: Experience from the same environments
condition_checks.condition_definition: Memory is built from the same applications/environments (self-supervised exploration on benchmark initial states) (2410.08164#s2).

condition_checks.reason: Successful trajectories are summarized by the Task Evaluator pipeline and a no-knowledge control is given. No raw-log versus summary-only ablation.
condition_checks.condition_name: Summaries rather than raw trajectories, with ablation
condition_checks.condition_definition: Stored experience is summarised by a self-evaluator, and removing the summaries is ablated (26.15 -> 18.46) (2410.08164#s2).

condition_checks.reason: A fixed cap of three retrieved logs is stated, but no memory-library-size or retrieved-count scaling study is reported in the complete knowledge evaluation.
condition_checks.condition_name: Memory-size scaling reported
condition_checks.condition_definition: Scaling with memory size is reported: continuous (Q-Former) memory scales log-linearly where text memory degrades beyond ~10 items (2510.09038#s1).

condition_checks.reason: Host/app hierarchy and retrieved documentation/logs guide subtasks, but this is not the full web-search+narrative-queue mechanism of K28 and is not claimed as such.
condition_checks.condition_name: Hierarchical planning with retrieved knowledge
condition_checks.condition_definition: A manager fuses web search and narrative memory into a subtask queue executed by workers, with replanning on failure; requires a proprietary MLLM, web search and an accessibility tree (2410.08164#s1).

condition_checks.reason: Own successful runs are distilled for later use and compared with no library. Applicability/precondition checks are not independently audited; o1 WAA regresses.
condition_checks.condition_name: Distilled, reusable knowledge from own runs
condition_checks.condition_definition: What worked is distilled into element-function documents, tips, precondition-guarded shortcuts or code tools and injected into later tasks, with the gain reported against no library (AppAgent SR 48.9% -> 73.3% with stable element ids; Mobile-Agent-E SS 75.1 -> 86.9; SheetCopilot tasks 0% -> 60%) (2312.13771#s2, 2501.11733#s3, 2402.07456#s3).

condition_checks.reason: No isolated OOD memory gain or layout-shift retrieval audit; this is missing generalization evidence, not an observed retrieval-drift rate.
condition_checks.condition_name: Small out-of-distribution gain
condition_checks.condition_definition: OOD gains are small (OSWorld 26.40 -> 26.73) and retrieval drifts under UI shifts (2510.09038#s1).

condition_checks.reason: LLM Task Evaluator success labels gate storage; no independent false-accept/reject agreement measurement.
condition_checks.condition_name: Self-evaluator / reflector not validated
condition_checks.condition_definition: Self-evaluator correctness is unmeasured; reflector labels disagree with humans ~25% (2410.08164#s2, 2311.08649#s2).

condition_checks.reason: No explicit memory-build versus held-out-environment isolation.
condition_checks.condition_name: Held-out environment gains not isolated
condition_checks.condition_definition: Gains on environments other than those the memory was built from are not isolated (2410.08164#s2).

condition_checks.reason: Table6 ablation exists, but without repeats; PRR measures recovered failures and does not establish net SR improvement. Execution-error prevalence is not invented.
condition_checks.condition_name: Thin ablations and execution-dominated failures
condition_checks.condition_definition: Ablations on 65 tasks with a single run; execution errors account for 79.59% of failures (2410.08164#s1).

condition_checks.reason: Task-tailored documents and unspecified archive chronology leave future-query leakage/error propagation unresolved. The o1 WAA regression is observed counterevidence, not proof of leakage.
condition_checks.condition_name: Distilled knowledge leaks test queries or propagates errors
condition_checks.condition_definition: Reflectors saw future queries or learning explores the same benchmark's dev set; shortcuts are misused on misperceived preconditions and flawed shortcuts propagate errors; the gain is small or absent with another backbone (Gemini-1.5-pro) (2501.11733#s3, 2402.07456#s3, 2312.13771#s2).
